Exam Date & Time: 09-May-2025 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  Manipal Institute of Technology, Bengaluru  
  BTech VI Semester  
  End Semester Examination - April / May -2025  
  INFORMATION RETRIEVAL [IT-4409]  
Marks: 50                                                                           Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
1)           Apply the impact of Boolean retrieval on search engine efficiency compared to  
  ranked retrieval models.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Interpret the effectiveness of different term normalization techniques (stemming vs.  
  lemmatization) in index construction.                                                   (5)  
  
2)           Apply the impact of Heap's Law on vocabulary growth in large-scale information  
  retrieval systems. How does it influence dictionary compression techniques?  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Apply the cosine similarity measure and comment about influences document  
  ranking in VSM.  
  
  • Doc1: "Machine learning is powerful."                                             (5)  
  • Doc2: "Deep learning improves AI."  
  • Doc3: "AI and machine learning are evolving."  
  
  
3)           Apply the precision-recall tradeoff concept to evaluate the effectiveness of a search  
  system given the following dataset:  
  
  A)          • Retrieved relevant documents: 20                                                  (5)  
  • Retrieved non-relevant documents: 30  
  
  Total relevant documents in the corpus: 50  
  
  B)      Compare relevance feedback and pseudo-relevance feedback.                               (5)  
4)                                                                                                   (5)  
  
  
  A)

For the query "Al in Radiology", consider the following term presence in  
documents:  
a ce  
pe tols  
1. Calculate RSV scores assuming:  
$$o df{Al) = 2, df(Radiology) = 2, N = 3.$$  
Critically analyze why a document containing both terms (D2) should rank  
higher than others in a clinical context.  
B) Discuss the search user experience in the case of a social media website. (5)  
5) A search engine company wants to optimize its web crawler to improve efficiency  
and reduce redundant crawling. Given the following scenario:  
A) ¢ The company has a database of 1 billion URLs, but 20% are duplicate or near-  
duplicate.  
¢ The crawler operates 24/7 but experiences frequent slowdowns due to large  
web pages and dynamic content. (5)  
¢ Some websites block the crawler due to excessive requests, leading to  
incomplete data collection.  
Interpret a crawling strategy that improves efficiency while maintaining  
comprehensive web coverage.  
B) Discuss methods to handle duplicate content and reduce unnecessary crawling. (5)  
-----End-----
